name: Lakefront Hotel Group
note: Synthetic demonstration hotel chain. The five properties, their names and locations are invented to show the portfolio view; their inputs are documented assumptions, and every value the input leaves out is a default the profile flags. Two properties reuse the single-hotel presets (Lakeshore Inn and Riverwalk Grand), so their figures match the single-hotel demo. All five use Chicago weather (O'Hare normals), Illinois rates and ComEd incentives. Brands, regions and ownership types are invented for the demonstration.
